en.subtitle: Junior IT System Administrator | IT Support L1/L2 | Windows · Networking · Security & Backups
en.summary: Junior IT support technician with hands-on experience in L1/L2 user support, Windows workstation maintenance, and infrastructure operations. Currently supporting a dental practice end-to-end: diagnosing hardware/software faults, deploying systems and peripherals, and documenting interventions for non-technical staff. Administers Linux servers (VPS, Docker, Nginx, SSL) with uptime monitoring and incident resolution, and has deployed IP surveillance infrastructure covering Ethernet cabling, IP addressing, and router/firewall configuration for secure remote access. Bachelor in Information Systems (Highest Honors); professional English and French, native Arabic; eager to grow into Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft infrastructure under senior guidance.

skills.items: User support for hardware and software issues, Windows workstation maintenance and troubleshooting, PC assembly and deployment, software installations and updates, peripheral setup, documented incident follow-up.
Windows 10/11 (installation, configuration, troubleshooting), Linux (CLI, server administration: Docker, Nginx, VPS).
TCP/IP, IP addressing and subnetting, Ethernet cabling, router configuration, firewall rules, VPN/secure remote access, LAN concepts (DNS/DHCP fundamentals).
Access control, SSL certificates, secure remote access, automated backups, data-handling best practices, IT documentation and asset records.
Python scripting for task automation, Git/GitHub, Postman, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel).
